title: Softmax Cross-Entropy: Loss and Gradient
hints: Treat each row on its own and work in log space: the loss only needs the log-probability of each example's correct class.
Differentiate a single example's loss with respect to its own logits first. The softmax Jacobian looks messy, but combined with the −log it collapses into something simple.
A row's softmax is unchanged if you add one constant to every logit. Choose it so no exponent is positive, and never take the log of a probability.
